name: orSlow
why: Japanese workwear and military-pattern denim, shirts and fatigue trousers under a slow-clothes concept, operated from Nishinomiya, Hyogo.
origin: Founded in 2005 (orslow.clothing footer; press: Heddels per brief, Highsnobiety). Conflict: 2004 per Nakatsu quoted on Meadow, a retailer blog in Kobe (orslow.clothing/about-us/, brand-run on Sebastian ruling). Third-party directory made-in-japan.jp gives address Nishinomiya, Hyogo (press/other) by Ichiro Nakatsu (orslow.clothing About and footer and press: Heddels 2025 calls him founder and head designer).

craft_evidence.owned: claim only, unconfirmed: a third-party directory (made-in-japan.jp) describes a Nishinomiya atelier with vintage Union Special and Singer machines; orslow.clothing says only manufacturing partner facilities operate under Japanese labor law, no owned facility stated
craft_evidence.makers: NONE (no factory or maker named on 8 product pages, About, or the press read)
craft_evidence.mills: NONE (no mill named on 8 product pages or About; Kind Curations interview mentions unnamed fabric makers and an old-style shuttle loom)
craft_evidence.madein: site-wide only: About says All OrSlow products are manufactured in Japan; 0 of 8 product pages state a country
craft_evidence.heritage: partly dated and placed, sources conflict: orslow.clothing says founded 2005 by Ichiro Nakatsu in Kobe; Nakatsu in a retailer interview (Meadow) says 2004
craft_evidence.process: site: small-batch, Slow-Made, no specifics; press: garments pre-washed (Nakatsu, Heddels 2025), old-style shuttle loom (Nakatsu, Kind Curations retailer blog 2023); no process on product pages
craft_evidence.reasoning: Made-in-Japan is stated site-wide (About) and in press, which is a country and a region (Okayama and Kobe textile expertise) but no named factory, mill or owned workshop; product pages carry no origin, fabric or construction text. Press adds a pre-wash and shuttle-loom detail from Nakatsu, so not a 1. Sits at 2 on the evidence read; could move to 3 if the real brand pages name makers (not reachable here). Low confidence.

ownership.owner: not stated on orslow.clothing (no company named). Press/other: Base Denim Products Co., Ltd. operates the brand per made-in-japan.jp

opview: “Since raw denim shrinks significantly when washed, we pre-wash our garments to ensure a more accurate fit from the start.” — Ichiro Nakatsu, founder and head designer (press interview, quoted by Heddels), Heddels, A Conversation with orSlow's Ichiro Nakatsu
